sentences.l2: 那位顾客在网上买了一件外套，收到后觉得颜色与图片相去甚远，于是在签收后的第五天提出七天无理由退货。
sentences.l1: That customer bought a coat online, and on receiving it felt the color was far from the picture, so on the fifth day after signing for it she requested a seven-day no-reason return.

sentences.l2: 客服却以吊牌已被剪去、包装出现磨损为由，认为商品已影响二次销售，拒绝受理。
sentences.l1: Customer service, however, on the grounds that the hang tag had been cut off and the packaging was worn, took the view that the goods had already affected resale and refused to handle the request.

sentences.l2: 顾客反复强调，自己只是试穿了一次，并未真正穿着外出，而平台规则中也没有把试穿列为不可退货的情形。
sentences.l1: The customer repeatedly stressed that she had only tried it on once and had not really worn it outside, and that the platform's rules did not list trying on as a situation in which returns are not allowed.

sentences.l2: 双方各执一词，沟通几轮后陷入僵局。
sentences.l1: Each side stuck to its own story, and after a few exchanges they hit a deadlock.

sentences.l2: 为了尽快了结此事，她只得自费把衣服寄回，并保留快递单号作为凭据，要求平台先行退款。
sentences.l1: In order to settle the matter as soon as possible, she had no choice but to ship the clothes back at her own expense, and kept the courier tracking number as proof, asking the platform to refund her first.

sentences.l2: 然而等了将近两周，退款仍未到账，客服的回复始终是"正在核实"。
sentences.l1: Yet after waiting nearly two weeks, the refund still had not arrived, and customer service's reply was always "under verification".

sentences.l2: 她最终给出差评，在评价里完整描述了交涉的经过。
sentences.l1: She finally gave a bad review, describing the whole course of the negotiation in detail in the review.

sentences.l2: 她坦言，自己并不在意那几百元，真正令人失望的，是白纸黑字的规则被随意解释，消费者的信任也在一次次推诿中被消耗殆尽。
sentences.l1: She frankly said that she did not mind about those few hundred yuan, and that what was truly disappointing was that rules in black and white were interpreted arbitrarily, and consumers' trust was also used up through one instance after another of passing the buck.
